record.body:
## Description

Single command writes contract views under store/views/; validate_immutability exempts views/*.md.

## Approach

Add view --write (or sync-views) that renders all (or selected) contract views to <store>/views/. In validation.py validate_immutability, skip paths under views/. Test dirty views no longer fail validate when digest otherwise ok.

payload.title: View sync command and views/ immutability exemption

record.subject: view-sync-exempt
